summary: A host that announces no capability at all still answers a working search: the field, the results and the keyboard need none of them.

then.note: results and echo are the whole of the base: no scopes, no recent, no popular, no correction, no preview. The panel draws the rows, marks the match, moves the selection with the arrows and opens one with Enter. A host adds a capability when it can answer more, never to make the search work.
